description: This file defines the 'Notes' class implementing note management functionalities for the Notesnook project, including adding, retrieving, exporting, duplicating, and deleting notes, as well as managing note relations and cache.

classes.name: Notes
classes.description: A class managing note entities, including CRUD operations, exporting, duplication, relation management, and cache handling within the Notesnook application.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the collection and cache, setting total notes count.

methods.name: buildCache
methods.description: Builds the cache of archived note IDs.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds or updates a note with content, handling title formatting and content saving.

methods.name: note
methods.description: Retrieves a note by ID if not trashed or deleted.

methods.name: trashed
methods.description: Retrieves a trashed note by ID.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Fetches tags associated with a note.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns a filter for all active (non-deleted, non-archived) notes.

methods.name: exportable
methods.description: Returns a filter for notes eligible for export.

methods.name: pinned
methods.description: Returns a filter for pinned notes.

methods.name: conflicted
methods.description: Returns a filter for conflicted notes.

methods.name: favorites
methods.description: Returns a filter for favorite notes.

methods.name: archived
methods.description: Returns a filter for archived notes.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a note exists by ID.

methods.name: moveToTrash
methods.description: Moves notes to trash.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes notes permanently.

methods.name: pin
methods.description: Sets pinned state for notes.

methods.name: favorite
methods.description: Sets favorite state for notes.

methods.name: archive
methods.description: Archives or unarchives notes.

methods.name: setExpiryDate
methods.description: Sets expiry date for notes.

methods.name: readonly
methods.description: Sets readonly state for notes.

methods.name: localOnly
methods.description: Sets local-only state for notes.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports a note in specified format, optionally embedding media and applying templates.

methods.name: duplicate
methods.description: Duplicates notes, including content and relations.

methods.name: _delete
methods.description: Deletes notes, either moving to trash or permanently deleting.

methods.name: addToNotebook
methods.description: Associates notes with a notebook.

methods.name: removeFromNotebook
methods.description: Removes notes from a specific notebook.

methods.name: removeFromAllNotebooks
methods.description: Removes notes from all notebooks.

methods.name: contentBlocks
methods.description: Retrieves content blocks of a note.

methods.name: contentBlocksWithLinks
methods.description: Retrieves content blocks with links of a note.

methods.name: internalLinks
methods.description: Retrieves internal links within a note.

methods.name: deleteExpiredNotes
methods.description: Deletes notes that have expired based on expiry date.
